telos: Minimize work the instructor performs for the system; maximize work the system performs for professional practice without changing professional authority.

invariants.rule: A fact already collected may not be required again unless the later representation has a distinct temporal or professional meaning that is explicitly stated.
Free reflection text may serve reflection and user-visible professional derivation, but may not be semantically mined to infer fatigue, emotion, personality, minimalism or UX state.
A derived representation must return visible professional value and disclose that it is derived rather than directly observed.
Each professional gate has one declared source of truth; UI copy, code and documentation must not redefine it independently.
The same term must keep the same semantic meaning across stages. Distinct temporal meanings must be named as distinct states rather than silently reused.
Absence of evidence may be represented as missing, pending or unresolved; it may not be described as an observed professional finding.
Claims about local storage, export and organizational projection must match the actual data path and distinguish automatic transmission from explicit user export.
Detection, interpretation, recommendation, authorization, execution and propagation are distinct states. An auditor finding does not authorize a professional change.
README, contracts, user-facing guidance and implementation must describe the same currently deployed behavior.

pendingAuthorityConflicts.conflict: scoreDimensions floors every dimension at 2/5 even when its evidence array is empty, while product copy states that missing evidence is not invented.
pendingAuthorityConflicts.containment: The conflict is registered and CI requires it to remain explicit. Do not reinterpret or change the approved score floor automatically. A domain decision must determine whether the display should suppress an unevidenced score or the scoring rule itself should change.
